brand.name: Ember & Oak
brand.tagline: Slow mornings. Small-batch coffee. Roasted out the back, poured right here.
brand.description: Ember & Oak Coffee is a fictional café used as a concept demo: small-batch coffee, all-day dining, private events and a cinematic 3D hero.
brand.demoFooter: Concept demo by KB Ventures. Not a real business.
brand.conceptLine: Concept website by KB Ventures. Want one for your business?

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Small-batch coffee, all-day dining and long tables in Melbourne. A cinematic concept demo for a fictional café.

pages.title: Menu
pages.description: Coffee, tea, food, bakery, cold drinks and evening cocktails. Order ahead for pick-up (demo).
pages.lead: Forty-one things to eat and drink, all made on site. Order ahead for pick-up, or just walk in.

pages.title: Shop beans & gear
pages.description: Freshly roasted beans, brewing gear and gifts from our roastery. Pick-up or delivery (demo).
pages.lead: Take the roast home. Every bag is roasted to order and shipped within ten days.

pages.title: Experiences, events & gift cards
pages.description: Roastery tours, barista workshops, private dining, catering, weekly events and gift cards.
pages.lead: Tours, workshops, private dining and the regular happenings at the café.

pages.title: Our story
pages.description: How a second-hand roaster and a patient landlord became Ember & Oak. Our farm-to-cup process and our team.
pages.lead: A tiny drum roaster, a converted timber workshop and a lot of free cups.

pages.title: Sustainability
pages.description: Compostable cups, farm premiums, roasting energy and how we reduce waste.
pages.lead: Honest numbers about what we do well, and what we are still fixing.

pages.title: Visit & FAQ
pages.description: Opening hours, address, getting here, accessibility and frequently asked questions.
pages.lead: Find us, check the hours, and get answers to the questions we hear most.

pages.title: Reserve a table
pages.description: Book a table, a class, private dining or catering. Demo form.
pages.lead: Tell us when and how many. We confirm by email, usually within a few hours.

pages.title: Journal
pages.description: Stories from the roastery, the kitchen and the oak room.
pages.lead: Short stories about coffee, baking and the people in our room.

pages.title: Careers
pages.description: Join the Ember & Oak crew. Open roles in the café, kitchen and roastery.
pages.lead: We hire for kindness first and teach the rest. These roles are fictional.

pages.title: Wholesale
pages.description: Freshly roasted beans for cafés, offices and restaurants, with training and equipment support.
pages.lead: Weekly roasted beans, proper training and a team that picks up the phone.
